posts.author: Arun4
posts.text: UPI Is charged Now onwards — @FVS there are no charges levied by zerodha but there may be charges by banks for the selected payment method however as per rbi guidelines neft method is compulsorily made free for savings account (in any bank). In my case as I mentioned kotak bank provide free imps but au bank charges for imps so I use NEFT with au bank. Only drawback for neft is that it takes around 30 mins for the transfer to be completed. You can check with your bank if imps is free you can use it. However there are some instances where NetBanking should be preferred as au bank charges 15 rs p…

posts.author: pothi
posts.text: UPI Is charged Now onwards — Please reach out to Zerodha support if you still have doubts. They’d give confirmation in writing. That helps in the future too. Yes, I never had a charge for internal transfer within bank (HDFC). I regularly transfer funds not just to my Zerodha trading account, but also to buy mutual funds via Coin that is based on HDFC account too. Please see How to make payments using NEFT or RTGS on Coin? Please know that the acknowledgement for transfer to mutual fund account comes hours later , even if the fund is settled to the virtual beneficiary account instantly.

posts.author: BB789
posts.text: UPI Is charged Now onwards — Make sure to deregister in the app first. Otherwise someone can still send money to that handle. If some criminal somehow sends something to that handle, your upi linked bank account maybe frozen for transactions related to criminal activity. Alternatively, your netbanking can fully disable upi on your account

posts.author: cvs
posts.text: UPI Is charged Now onwards — However, that’s not what Pothi’s referring to above. They are referring to an intra bank transfer. No. It is neither. It is an Intra Bank transfer within the bank that is NOT routed via IMPS (NPCI) as it does not support it. Can specifically read about it for HDFC bank - here . For more details surrounding IMPS and UPI, can checkout this case-study slide-deck. (slides 35,36 for a quick overview) fastpayments.worldbank.org World_Bank_FPS_India_IMPS_and_UPI_Case_Study.pdf
